primary.decision_rule: positive in both families: consistent support on this suite; positive pooled but nonpositive in at least one family: mixed; nonpositive pooled: no pooled gain
primary.uncertainty: descriptive finite-suite contrasts only; no population p-values or confidence intervals

secondary.full_read: once per primary snapshot, outside the equal-budget comparison

execution.stop: one complete, audited sweep; no adaptive exclusions or sample size updates
execution.integrity: abort the entire sweep on a fixture or engine error, missing or duplicate cell, or invalid audit from a read-based policy; record the deviation, preserve the failed attempt, and rerun only from a documented revision
execution.amendments: new commit with rationale before viewing affected outcomes; after viewing outcomes report changed analyses as exploratory
